svg.title: How an Apple Reference Image is made
svg.desc: Four steps: the sensor signs the pixels, the Secure Enclave signs the camera settings, the phone saves a secure digital negative, and Private Cloud Compute checks everything, develops the photo and signs it.
svg.text: How a reference image is made

g.text: It reboots into a locked mode and seals the raw frame.
The Secure Enclave signs the settings
Zoom, focal length and timestamps get their own seal.
The phone saves a digital negative
A DNG file holds the raw pixels and both signatures.
Apple's cloud checks, develops and signs
Private Cloud Compute verifies it, then makes the JPEG.
